retrieval: CANONICAL_REFERENCE_MAP.json maps SHA and bytes to canonical path; alias indexes resolve to INPUT_MAP original path and supplied manifest SHA. Manifest bytes themselves are preserved. Earlier V5/V6 maps remain unchanged.
method: All supplied manifest hashes and declared members verified before copies. New copies fsync, mode0444, atomic renamex_np RENAME_EXCL, readback SHA/size check; existing exact objects reused with verification. No overwrite or WORM claim.
scope_limit: Only explicit members and manifest bytes of eight closed packets; no active POINT_VISUAL_DIAGNOSIS_V30A or later work; no recursive directory inventory.
preservation: Originals and checkpoint history retained; failed/aborted attribution preserved without reinterpretation. No deletion, symlink replacement, maintained source edit, Git/index mutation, tests/build/browser/native/server action.
acceptance: Historical derivative preservation only; no product/method/performance/tranche acceptance or release claim.
